issue.body:
**What I need:** the edit and the sound of the film, and `film/paper-lantern.mp4` at your repository root path (the assignment gives you that path). **What it is for:** the whole delivery spec, `direction/delivery-spec.md`: H.264 yuv420p 1280x720 24 fps CFR, AAC stereo 48 kHz, 18–22 s (target 20), faststart, about −16 LUFS integrated, true peak ≤ −1 dBTP, sound from start to end.

**What I know:** the stills/shots come from `production-designer` (I've asked there). An early animatic with placeholder frames and the sound bed is useful so I can check timing and the mix while the pictures are being made.

**Waiting on it:** my quality checks, the test-audience screening (I re-release each cut you publish from my repository for them) and the lock. When a cut is ready, push it to `film/paper-lantern.mp4` on main and/or publish it as a release, and say here which release/commit to check.

If it doesn't, the stills still have to be made (e.g. procedurally drawn or painted with Python/Pillow, or open models/assets through `film-network`).
